test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of 2024, how many members are there in the steering committee of the GlobE Network, in which India has been elected as a member, as announced by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **GlobE Network** (Global Operational Network of Anti-Corruption Law Enforcement Authorities) was established under the **United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)**.
 
• It** aims to strengthen international cooperation** in combating corruption.
 
• The steering committee, comprising **15 members**, plays a crucial role in guiding the network's initiatives and strategies.
 
• India, represented by the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)**, was elected as a member of the steering committee, showcasing its leadership in global anti-corruption efforts.
 
• The **election to the steering committee was part of the GlobE Network's annual plenary meeting in Beijing, held in September 2024.**
 
• India’s inclusion reflects its growing influence in international law enforcement and anti-corruption initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The CBI was established in 1963 by a resolution made by the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• It was established on the recommendation of the **Santhanam Committee **on the prevention of corruption (1962 -64)
 
• CBI attributes its powers to the Delhi Special Police Establishment Act of 1946.
 
• CBI is the major investigating agency of the Central Government and it performs an integral role in the prevention of corruption.
 
• The Director of CBI is responsible for the administration of the organisation.
 
• CBI now works under the Ministry of Personnel, Pension & Public Grievances, Government of India, and coordinates the investigation on behalf of the Interpol Member countries.
